cash_breakdown.item: Cash at banks and in hand
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Group cash was disclosed only at consolidated level across Hong Kong, PRC, Singapore, UK and other regulated asset-management subsidiaries; parent/subsidiary split and regulatory liquid-capital buffer were not disclosed.
cash_breakdown.reason: Potentially cash-like, but only partly detachable under control-owner view.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Short-term bank deposits mature within one year, but consolidated location and regulated-entity needs were not split.
cash_breakdown.reason: Cash-like asset with moderate cross-entity and working-capital haircut.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Reported inside cash equivalents, but it is held by an asset manager with regulatory capital requirements and no instrument-level liquidity or counterparty detail.
cash_breakdown.reason: Treated as detachable only after a large quality and availability haircut.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Broker deposits are operating or trading infrastructure funds, not clean excess cash.

Only the current portion of investments was admitted to the detachable pool. The company states proprietary and seed investments support new funds and investor alignment; market and liquidity risk remain.
cash_breakdown.reason: Potentially saleable, but not equivalent to cash.

cash_breakdown.item: Non-current investments, investment property and joint ventures
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Non-current investments include associates, unlisted funds, seed capital, real estate partnership/JV exposures and investment property. These are not ordinary detachable cash assets for this screen.
cash_breakdown.reason: Recorded as economic asset pool but excluded from net cash deduction.

cash_breakdown.item: Bank loan secured by New Zealand investment property
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Interest-bearing bank borrowing is deducted at 100%; the loan is secured by investment property and matures within one year.

cash_breakdown.item: Necessary operating and regulated capital cash reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Estimated from 2024 total expenses, distribution fee payable cycle, negative net cash used in operations, and SFO/SFA/AMAC/FCA regulated-entity capital requirements.
cash_breakdown.reason: Retained for business continuity and license capital/liquidity needs.

cash_breakdown.item: Tax, FX and dividend friction reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Consolidated cash includes multiple currencies and operating jurisdictions; parent/subsidiary extraction path is not disclosed.
cash_breakdown.reason: Reserve for repatriation, FX, tax and distribution friction.

profit_quality.assessment: 普通企业式现金利润分母无法成立。2022-2024 年费率业务在扣除投资及汇兑等其他 gains/losses 前连续经营亏损，2024 年归母利润 HKD 31.235m 主要由 HKD 179.260m 投资净收益抵消经营亏损、汇兑损失和 JV 损失形成；2024 年经营现金流为 HKD -2.094m。
adjustments: 剔除 2024 年投资净收益 HKD 179.260m、公允价值/处置/投资相关收益和汇兑损失后，经营业务本身为亏损 HKD 46.436m。
三年归母利润分别为 2022 年 HKD -544.315m、2023 年 HKD 23.088m、2024 年 HKD 31.235m，中位数虽为正，但由投资和市场波动支撑，不可作为主业可分配现金利润。
三年经营现金流分别为 2022 年 HKD -76.641m、2023 年 HKD 56.325m、2024 年 HKD -2.094m，现金化不稳定。
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2024 年经营现金流为负；2023 年转正主要含 HKD 95.167m tax received；2022 年经营现金流为负。
profit_quality.haircut_reason: 不是低质量利润简单折扣，而是连续三年核心费率业务亏损，分母无法用普通经营企业公式成立。
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: 不可用：报表利润主要受自有投资公允价值、处置、汇兑和 JV 损益影响。
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: 2024 年购买物业、设备及无形资产 HKD 1.006m；资本开支很低，但不能修复经营分母。
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2024 年经营现金流调节显示 fee receivables 释放 HKD 18.651m、其他应付款增加 HKD 18.198m，但 net cash used in operations 仍为 HKD -40.416m。
